string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: Games redone like the home screen: recently played with the app icon, On the couch (controllers and pairing), Your Discord crew (voice room with QR, who is online, call the crew) and More options
Games: the This week card shows the network and how much was played in the last 7 days
Bigger letters in Settings, Extras, Diagnostics and the other inner screens
Each world has its color: the background of movie and TV screens leans orange, radio and podcasts teal, games indigo
TV, movie and series players use only the Sofaly orange (no more yellow, green and red)
Time left always shows the same way across the system: “1 h 5 min”
Movies and Series no longer open empty on “All 0”
Radios opens on recent stations when there are no favorites yet
Alarm clock: the wheel has the bigger number on top, holding an arrow turns it slowly, and the options no longer show under the lists

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: Open Games: do ◀ ▶ switch between Recently played, On the couch, Your crew and More options, does each game show the app icon, and does OK open the game?
In Settings, are the letters bigger with no explanation cut off with “…”?
Open Movies: does the grid show the movies with focus on one (not “All 0”)?
